QuestInfo.name: Secret Ritual
QuestInfo.0: You've gathered all four powers of light within the Vampiric Lantern. You can now complete the ritual to reach Harmony.
QuestInfo.1: Find someplace secluded and quiet for the ritual. Grendel the Really Old says that the #bportal east of the Golem Temple Entrance#k will take you to such place. #bDouble-click on the #i2430873# Vampiric Lantern#k to get to the Golem's Temple.
QuestInfo.2: This is the perfect place for your ritual.

0.1: What is it now? I've helped you enough!"\r\n#L0##bCalm yourself, old man. All I need is a secluded place to do my ritual. Preferably someplace with an ample supply of magical energy.#l\n#k
0.2: Hm. I know just the place. The Black Wings used to hold their meetings there; seems like a good fit for someone like you. Head to the #beast end of the Golem Temple Entrance#k and take the portal. #bDouble-click on the Vampiric Lantern#k to teleport nearby.

yes.0: Heed my words. The power of darkness is much more dangerous than you think. Learn to control it before the worst happens.

no.0: Do whatever you want. Just LEAVE!

0.0: Now get out of my town! But I want you to come back when you are able fully control both light and darkness. Didn't you acquire everything you needed?\r\n#L0##bDon't be so hasty. There's one more thing I need.#l\n#k

1.0: This place will suit my needs.
